definitions.gloss: descendants for generations to come; one's posterity
definitions.explanation: All of one's descendants, generation after generation, into the far future. A four-character compound formed by doubling each kanji of {子孫|しそん} (descendants); used in formal speech and writing, often in {子々孫々|ししそんそん}まで (down to the last generation).

examples.japanese: {子々孫々|ししそんそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: To hand down to generations to come.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{恩|おん}→恩：02550_on⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子々孫々|ししそんそん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{忘|わす}れない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: Our family will never forget this kindness, down to the last generation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{子々孫々|ししそんそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧だ。
examples.english: It is our responsibility to leave this beautiful nature to the generations that follow us.

notes:
Also written {子子孫孫|ししそんそん}. The 々 repeats the kanji before it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子々孫々|ししそんそん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: down to the remotest descendants
- {子々孫々|ししそんそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to pass down through the generations
- {子々孫々|ししそんそん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave for future generations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{子孫|しそん}→子孫：00372_shison⟧: descendants (the everyday word)
- {末代|まつだい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: for all generations to come (often of shame or fame)
- ⟦{代々|だいだい}→代々：05899_daidai⟧: for generations (looking back at the past)
